hypothesis: Compare default DP with min_launches using one captured graph/cost set and identical dynamic arrivals; no service claim.
controls: Native top8, BF16 codec, dedicated capture, same initial all model/codec states, request metadata and sampling RNG; reset before every arm. Default-off mixed layout/conv/defer flags remain off.
gate: Exact per-step roster/codes/metadata, all final mutable tensors including scratch, PCM bytes and completion ordering against DP/sync; no dropped requests.
stop: Any divergence ends this experiment with raw failure evidence; no favorable retry or full-service run.
scope: 80 scripted requests/slot reuse; this does not establish full1088 quality or a timing gain.
